groundTruth: Read with the RDC-Tool CLI from a replay of the capture: rd.event.get_action_tree and rd.pipeline.get_state at event 11.

prompt.zh-CN:
打开项目里的 vkcube_lavapipe.rdc，只根据回放结果回答下面的问题。最后按每题一行给出答案，格式为 `Q<编号>: <答案>`。
Q1 这一帧唯一的 draw 调用是哪个事件 ID？
Q2 它绘制了多少个顶点？
Q3 这个 draw 的颜色渲染目标是什么格式、多大尺寸？
Q4 这一帧一共有多少个 action（事件树中的全部节点）？
Q5 哪个事件 ID 把这一帧呈现（present）出去？
Q6 这个 draw 绑定了哪些着色器阶段？
prompt.en:
Open vkcube_lavapipe.rdc in this project and answer only from what the replay shows. End with one line per question in the form `Q<number>: <answer>`.
Q1 Which event ID is the frame's only draw call?
Q2 How many vertices does it draw?
Q3 What format and size is that draw's color render target?
Q4 How many actions does the frame have (all nodes of the action tree)?
Q5 Which event ID presents the frame?
Q6 Which shader stages are bound at that draw?
